headline: SUPERSEDES 20260826T105610Z-trigger2-blueprint-v2-leakage-audit-claude-code-lead.json: the ~0.276-bit 'higher-order nuisance leak' reported there was a misattributed measurement, not a real generator defect. Corrected via chatgpt-secondary review, independently reproduced by claude-code-lead before acceptance.
state: chatgpt-secondary (triggerwort2, conversation c/6a8ec676) reviewed commit ece5a0d and showed check_higher_order_joint_mi() in tools/trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2_leakage_audit_v1.py computed joint MI over ALL 9072 rows combined (TRAIN+VALIDATION+HOLDOUT_FROZEN together) rather than within each split. The observed 0.276195...bit signal is exactly I(target;template) alone: HOLDOUT_FROZEN intentionally uses a disjoint unseen symbol pool (12-14) exclusively under template T6, so template identity alone predicts the target's 3-symbol pool -- that is the DESIGNED unseen-symbol-holdout evaluation, not a leak. claude-code-lead independently reproduced this before accepting it (not taken on assertion): within-split I(target;perm x template) is exactly 0.0 in TRAIN (n=6912), VALIDATION (n=1728) and HOLDOUT_FROZEN (n=432) separately; and I(target;template x nuisance) - I(target;template) = ~1.1e-16 (numerically zero) over the combined corpus for every nuisance field. H5 ('pairwise zero-MI alone is insufficient') remains a correct general warning, but this specific experiment does not confirm it -- correct classification is TOOLING PASS / INTERPRETATION FAIL / GENERATOR NOT CONVICTED, exactly as chatgpt-secondary stated. Fixed tools/trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2_leakage_audit_v1.py (v1.1, in place, with a CORRECTION docstring documenting the fix and citing chatgpt-secondary's finding): check_higher_order_joint_mi() is now split-scoped (the actual leak test) plus an explicit excess-MI-over-template-baseline check (the correct generalization for cross-split MI, per chatgpt-secondary's suggested regression form); the old combined-corpus number is retained under informational_combined_corpus_joint_mi_bits, explicitly labeled EXPECTED_HOLDOUT_SUPPORT_SHIFT, and no longer gates pass. Added check_intended_split_support_shift() to state the by-design TRAIN==VALIDATION / HOLDOUT-disjoint symbol partition as its own documented fact rather than letting it hide inside an unscoped MI number. Also fixed the bag-of-words shortcut probe's pass condition to be one-sided (only above-chance accuracy is a leak signal; the prior two-sided +-5pp check was flagging classifier noise below chance as a false failure). tests/test_trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2_leakage_audit_v1.py updated to match (13/13 total tests green across both this file and the B0 baseline generator's tests). overall_pass is now True. All other v1 findings (exact prompt uniqueness, cross-split content disjointness, text-conditional target uniformity) were correct and remain unchanged. accepted_dataset_tokens remains 0; this correction changes an interpretation, not the admission boundary.
next: This correction cycle is itself the concrete example of the two-researcher governance model working as designed (CLAUDE_CODE_INTRODUCTION.md section 7): chatgpt-secondary produced a strong, evidence-based dissent against a claude-code-lead claim, lead reproduced the measurement independently rather than deferring OR dismissing, and the shared research state is now more accurate than either researcher's first pass alone. Continue with PR #1956's remaining next-exact-gates (46-atom ABI inventory, joint TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT split manifest, small audited pilot) on the confirmed-clean blueprint v2.1; no generator change is warranted by this cycle's findings.
